home.emptyTitle: Paste a video link to get started
home.emptySubtitle: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Reddit and more. After analyzing you'll see the video's details, formats and sizes.
home.cardsHint: Without a link, these cards open the tools for files on your computer. You can also drag a file onto the window.

analyze.moreHint: …and hundreds of other sites yt-dlp supports.

validation.unsupported: This link doesn't look like a supported platform yet.
validation.invalid: This doesn't look like a valid link.

media.previewUnavailable: This video can't be played inside the app (the platform restricts direct playback). You can open it at its source.

actions.downloadDesc: Download from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and more.
actions.convertDesc: Save as MP4, WebM, MP3, M4A and more.
actions.compressDesc: Shrink the file while keeping quality.

options.title: Processing options
options.subtitlesHint: {{langs}} subtitles are saved next to the video as .srt
options.shrinkHint: Also creates a compressed copy after downloading; the original is kept
options.analyzeFirst: Analyze a link first to see its formats.

presets.title: Format & quality presets
presets.quickSubtitle: Pick one and start right away

jobs.empty: Nothing here yet. Downloads and conversions you start will appear here with live progress.

notice.notSmaller: The file was already efficiently compressed and did not get smaller

jobs.interrupted: Stopped because the app was closed. Try again.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.subtitle: Every download and conversion in this session, with live progress.
downloads.sessionNote: Finished files are also saved in History.

batch.subtitle: Paste several links and add them all to the queue at once.
batch.usesOptions: The format and quality selected in the Basic tab are used.
batch.addedWithSkipped: {{count}} links added · {{skipped}} were already in the queue.

drop.title: Drag a file here or click to choose
drop.subtitle: Video or audio files: MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM, AVI, MP3, WAV…

convert.title: Convert
convert.subtitle: Change the format of a video or audio file on your computer.

compress.title: Compress
compress.subtitle: Shrink a local video while keeping as much quality as possible. The original is never changed.
compress.presetHighDesc: Up to 1080p, looks almost the same
compress.presetSmallDesc: 720p and at most 30 fps, smallest file
compress.tooSmall: This target is very small; because of the minimum quality limit the result may be slightly larger.
compress.summaryPreset: Original: {{size}} · the result is saved as a new MP4

resize.title: Resize
resize.subtitle: Target a resolution, an aspect ratio or a platform preset.
resize.fitCropDesc: Fills the frame, may crop the edges
resize.fitPadDesc: Keeps the whole frame, adds black bars

prepare.title: Prepare for platform
prepare.subtitle: Turn a video into the exact size TikTok, Reels, Shorts or Instagram expects.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: Everything you've downloaded or processed, and the links you searched.

error.analyzeHint: Check the link or try a different supported platform.
error.downloadFailed: The download couldn't finish. Try again.
error.resizeFailed: The job couldn't finish. Try again.
error.probeFailed: Couldn't read this file. Make sure it's a supported video or audio file.

settings.title: Settings
settings.notSet: Not set — you'll be asked the first time
settings.concurrencyHint: How many downloads/conversions run at the same time
settings.notifyOnComplete: Notify me when a job finishes
settings.updateFailed: Couldn't reach yt-dlp. Check your internet connection.
settings.ytdlpHint: If a platform suddenly stops working, updating yt-dlp usually fixes it.
settings.license: Free and open source (MIT). Uses yt-dlp and FFmpeg.
settings.disclaimer: DownKit doesn't break DRM or bypass access restrictions. Only download content you have the right to download or that the platform's terms allow.
settings.subtitle: Your preferences are stored on this computer.
settings.defaultFormatHint: The Home page starts with this format
settings.rateLimitHint: So downloads don't slow down the rest of your internet
settings.subtitleLangsHint: These languages are looked up when "Download subtitles" is on.
settings.autoSubtitlesHint: Uses machine captions when there are no written ones. YouTube often limits these; turn off if it causes problems.
settings.clipboardSuggestHint: Suggests the copied link when you come back to the window; never starts anything on its own.
settings.notifyOnCompleteHint: Only while the window is in the background.
settings.revealOnComplete: Show the file in its folder when done
settings.revealOnCompleteHint: Opens File Explorer for every finished file.
settings.toolNotInstalled: Not downloaded yet — fetched on first use
settings.denoNotInstalled: Fetched with the first YouTube link (needed for YouTube)
settings.autoUpdateYtdlp: Keep yt-dlp up to date automatically
settings.toolsFolderHint: Where yt-dlp, FFmpeg and Deno live
settings.keepHistoryHint: When off, downloads and searches aren't recorded.
settings.contactHint: Suggestions, bug reports, or just to say hi.
settings.groupByPlatformHint: Downloads go into YouTube, TikTok, Kick… subfolders of the save folder.
settings.closeBehaviorHint: Downloads keep running in the tray; right-click > Quit closes completely.
settings.checkUpdates: Check for a new version on start
settings.checkUpdatesHint: Lets you know in the status bar; never downloads anything on its own.
settings.donateHint: DownKit is completely free and will stay that way. If you like, a voluntary donation helps its development.

backendError.botCheck: The platform wants a bot check. Wait a bit and try again, or update yt-dlp in Settings.
backendError.drmProtected: This content is DRM-protected. DownKit doesn't download DRM-protected content.
backendError.privateVideo: This video is private; only people the owner allows can watch it.
backendError.ageRestricted: This video is age-restricted and can't be downloaded without signing in.
backendError.membersOnly: This content is members-only. DownKit doesn't bypass access restrictions.
backendError.geoBlocked: This video isn't available in your country.
backendError.notLiveYet: This stream hasn't started yet. Try again once it's live.
backendError.subtitlesFailed: Subtitles couldn't be downloaded (platform limit). Turn off "Download subtitles" and try again.
backendError.formatUnavailable: The selected quality isn't available for this video. Try "Best available".
backendError.rateLimited: The platform received too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
backendError.forbidden: The platform refused the download. Update yt-dlp in Settings and try again.
backendError.videoUnavailable: Video not found: it may have been removed or the link is wrong.
backendError.unsupportedPlatform: This link doesn't look like a supported platform.
backendError.diskFull: Not enough free disk space. Free up some space and try again.
backendError.permissionDenied: Couldn't write to the save folder. Pick a different folder in Settings.
backendError.ffmpegMissing: FFmpeg wasn't found, so video and audio couldn't be merged. Restart the app.
backendError.network: Couldn't reach the platform. Check your internet connection.
backendError.sourceCorrupt: The source file looks broken or incomplete.
backendError.analyzeTimeout: Fetching the video details timed out. Check the link or try again later.
backendError.analyzeFailed: Couldn't get the video details. Check the link or try again later.
backendError.emptyPlaylist: No downloadable videos were found in this playlist.
backendError.isPlaylist: This is a playlist link. Paste it on the Home page and pick the videos you want.
backendError.toolStartFailed: A required tool couldn't be started. Try restarting the app.
backendError.toolDownloadFailed: A required tool couldn't be downloaded. Check your internet connection.
backendError.downloadFailed: The download couldn't finish. Try again.
backendError.downloadNoFile: The download finished but the file location couldn't be read. Check the save folder.
backendError.convertFailed: The conversion couldn't finish. Try again.
backendError.channelOffline: This channel is not live right now. Try a link to one of its past broadcasts (VODs) or clips.
backendError.invalidRange: The end time must be after the start time.

playlist.truncated: Showing the first {{shown}} videos ({{total}} in the list).
playlist.partOfList: This video is part of a playlist.
playlist.noAdvanced: Every video in a playlist is different, so advanced format picking isn't available. The quality from the Basic tab is applied to each video.

sidebar.donateHint: DownKit is free; if you like, you can support it with a voluntary donation.

section.title: Download only part of the video
section.hint: Grab just the scene you want from a long video; the rest is never downloaded.
section.markHint: Play the video and mark the moment you want.

trim.title: Trim video
trim.subtitle: Cut the part you want out of a video on your computer into a new file. The original is never changed.
trim.fastDesc: Takes seconds with no quality loss; the cut may shift by a few seconds
trim.preciseDesc: Cuts on the exact frame; takes a bit longer
trim.noDuration: This file's length couldn't be read, so it can't be trimmed.

tray.hiddenBusy: Jobs are still running; you'll be notified when they finish. Click the duck in the tray to open it again.
tray.hiddenIdle: Click the duck in the tray to open it again. To quit completely: right-click > Quit.

update.failed: Couldn't check. Check your internet connection.
